description: Na₄Cd₇(N₅O₆)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share faces with two CdN₃O₃ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a faceface with one CdN₃O₃ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.35 Å) and three longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded to three N and three O atoms to form distorted CdN₃O₃ octahedra that share corners with three CdN₃O₃ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CdN₃O₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-45°. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.66 Å) Cd-N bond length. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and two longer (2.47 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded to three equivalent N and three equivalent O atoms to form CdN₃O₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent CdN₃O₃ octahedra, edges with three equivalent CdN₃O₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. All Cd-N bond lengths are 2.43 Å. All Cd-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. In the third Cd site, Cd is bonded to three N and three O atoms to form CdN₃O₃ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CdN₃O₃ octahedra, edges with three CdN₃O₃ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 36°. There is one shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Cd-N bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.29 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a linear geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.15 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) N-N bond length. In the second N site, N is bonded in a linear geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.14 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) N-N bond length. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of N-O bond distances ranging from 1.22-1.30 Å. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of N-O bond distances ranging from 1.23-1.33 Å. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.22 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) N-O bond lengths. In the sixth N site, N is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the seventh N site, N is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the eighth N site, N is bonded to four Cd and one N atom to form distorted NCd₄N trigonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NCd₃N tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NCd₄N trigonal bipyramids. In the ninth N site, N is bonded to three Cd and one N atom to form NCd₃N tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NCd₃N tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NCd₄N trigonal bipyramids. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one N atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one N atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one N atom.
